name: DonutChart
whenToUse: Parts of one whole, up to 7: storage by file type, plan mix, downloads by source.
When the total matters too — it sits in the center.

whenNotToUse.text: Comparing values that aren’t parts of a whole
More than 7 parts, or many tiny slices

anatomy.description: name and value per slice; `layout` vertical/horizontal.

do.caption: Three parts of one total, named in the legend.
do.example:
<DonutChart
  data={[{ label: 'RAW files', value: 62 }, { label: 'JPEGs', value: 24 }, { label: 'Exports', value: 14 }]}
  unit=" GB"
  layout="horizontal"
  height={160}
  ariaLabel="Storage by file type: RAW files 62 GB of 100 GB."
/>

dont.caption: Seven similar slices: angles this close can’t be compared — a sorted bar chart can.
dont.example:
<DonutChart
  data={[
    { label: 'Golden hour', value: 22 }, { label: 'Blue hour', value: 18 }, { label: 'First light', value: 16 },
    { label: 'Moonrise over Othrys', value: 14 }, { label: 'Wide-shining', value: 11 }, { label: 'Isthmian Five', value: 10 }, { label: 'Portfolio', value: 9 },
  ]}
  unit="%"
  layout="horizontal"
  height={160}
  ariaLabel="Downloads by gallery."
/>

a11y: `ariaLabel` states the takeaway; the legend repeats every name and value as text.
Slice colors aren’t the only cue — the legend order matches the ring.

props.name: slicePatterns
props.description:
Fill each slice after the first with its own pattern (lines, dots…) as
well as its color, so slices can be told apart without color (WCAG
1.4.1). The legend keys show the same pattern. Default false.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Ring band width: "default" (thicker) or "thin" (a slim indicator ring).
